latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Maker from Photo:

- Instantly turns uploaded photos (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) into MP4 slideshow videos with music and transitions.
- No editing software required; just describe your request and get video results in 30–60 seconds.
- Handles uploads up to 200MB, optimized for 5–10 photos for social videos.
- Automated cloud-based video rendering and export to 1080p MP4 format.
- Full support for checking credits, exporting, viewing timeline state, and error handling.
